page.title: The Stock Market
page.intro: (Almost) serious companies. Prices follow quarterly earnings, shareholders pocket dividends, and sometimes someone buys the whole thing. Or it all collapses.
page.recentEmpty: No reports yet. The first one drops soon.

takeover.label: Takeover bid · verdict in {time}
takeover.explain: If the bid goes through, every share held is bought out at that price and the stock is delisted. If it fails, the price drops back.

company.relist: The company will be back on the market about 24h later, with a fresh IPO price.

next.label: Next earnings (Q{quarter})
next.explain: Beat the consensus and the price climbs; miss it and it dives. Reports dropped outside trading hours hit at the open (gap).

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.noPayout: This company pays no dividend: it "reinvests".
dividends.paid: paid · {holders, plural, one {# shareholder} other {# shareholders}}
dividends.explain: The dividend goes to whoever holds the stock at the ex-dividend moment; the price then drops by the same amount.
